Set both on the global `Settings` object, before you build or query an index. `Settings` is a global singleton: "The `Settings` is a simple singleton object that lives throughout your application." ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md"]. Any component you don't pass explicitly falls back to it: "Whenever a particular component is not provided, the `Settings` object is used to provide it as a global default." ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md"]

**Embedding model:** The docs show this pattern: "Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding()" ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md"]. They also recommend setting the model explicitly: "We recommend doing this for new projects." ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md"] The excerpt I have cuts off the model-name example, so I won't quote a specific model name.

**LLM:** The retrieved excerpts don't include the exact `Settings.llm = ...` line. The Ollama example in the migration guide is cut off before it sets the LLM: "if you aren't using OpenAI, an example config might look like:" ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/service_context_migration.md"]. Based on the same `Settings` pattern, you would assign `Settings.llm` to your LLM instance, but I'm going from general knowledge here, not from these docs. Check the settings page for the exact attribute name.

Sketch (the embedding line is from the docs; the LLM line is an unverified assumption):

```python
from llama_index.core import Settings
from llama_index.embeddings.openai import OpenAIEmbedding

Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding()   # from the docs
# Settings.llm = ...                       # assumed pattern; verify in settings.md
```

Note that `Settings` applies to every LlamaIndex module, not just one index: "Configuring the global settings means you are change the default for EVERY module in LlamaIndex." ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/service_context_migration.md"] You can also override either model per index or per component.
